'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Steve Baroni LS Coruscant: Night Club (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steve Baroni]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Coruscant: Night Club (V) (Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith)|OVS16-30-Coruscant_Night_Club-remaster.webp|label=Coruscant: Night Club (V)}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Baroni
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
